inventory_text:
A1. subject | ui_label: Subject | type: text | required: yes | constraints: maxLength 175 | auto_filled: no
A2. description | ui_label: Description | type: textarea | required: no | constraints: none | auto_filled: no
A3. equipment | ui_label: Unit | type: select | required: no | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A4. service_type | ui_label: Service Type | type: select | required: yes | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A5. priority | ui_label: Priority | type: select | required: yes | constraints: none | auto_filled: yes
A6. files | ui_label: Attachment | type: file | required: no | constraints: Allowed file types: Image, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Eml, Easm, Mp4, Mov | auto_filled: no

B2. equipment -> service_type | EFFECT: filter | GUARD: formData.equipment | REVERSAL: reset service_type if no longer valid

C1. FIELD: customer | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C2. FIELD: user | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C3. FIELD: department | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C4. FIELD: staff_accountable | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C5. FIELD: staff_assigned | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion
C6. FIELD: due_date | CONDITION: {isAgent && (...)} | SHOWN TO: agent | HIDDEN FROM: customer | TYPE: role_exclusion

D1. customer CAN see the record | WHEN: they are the ticket owner or have visibility to the user
D2. customer CANNOT see the record | WHEN: they are not the ticket owner and do not have visibility to the user

E1. FIELD: equipment | SOURCE: known_entities.customers.equipment | DISPLAY LABEL: provision_name | SCOPE: current_user_org
E2. FIELD: service_type | SOURCE: known_entities.departments.service_types | DISPLAY LABEL: name | SCOPE: current_user_org
E3. FIELD: priority | SOURCE: ticketsService.fetchTicketPrioritiesService | DISPLAY LABEL: label | SCOPE: none

F1. FIELD: equipment | FILTER: equipment.status_id !== 0 && equipment.deletedAt === null
F2. FIELD: service_type | FILTER: ispublic: true
F3. FIELD: service_type | FILTER: role_unrestricted

scenarios.description: Customer creates a ticket with all required fields filled with valid values.

inputs.subject: Server not responding
inputs.description: The main server at Acme HQ is not responding.

scenarios.assertion: Ticket is successfully created and visible in the customer's ticket list.

scenarios.description: Attempt to create a ticket without providing the required 'Subject' field.

inputs.description: The server is not responding and needs immediate attention.

scenarios.assertion: Error message 'Subject is required.' is displayed.

scenarios.description: Test subject field with maximum allowed length of 175 characters.
scenarios.assertion: Form submits successfully with subject at max length.

scenarios.description: Test subject field with length exceeding maximum allowed length by one character.
scenarios.assertion: Error message displayed for subject exceeding max length.

scenarios.description: Test attachment field with an allowed file type (PDF).
scenarios.assertion: Form submits successfully with allowed file type.

scenarios.description: Test attachment field with a disallowed file type (exe).
scenarios.expected_message: File type not allowed. Please upload a valid file type.
scenarios.assertion: Error message displayed for disallowed file type.

scenarios.description: Attempt to upload an unsupported file type as an attachment.
scenarios.expected_message: Invalid file type. Allowed types are: Image, PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Eml, Easm, Mp4, Mov.
scenarios.assertion: Error message is displayed indicating the file type is not supported.

scenarios.description: Happy-order: Set equipment and assert service_type updates.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type dropdown updates based on selected equipment.

scenarios.description: Wrong-order: Interact with service_type first, then set equipment and assert service_type self-corrects.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type dropdown self-corrects based on selected equipment.

scenarios.description: Clear-trigger: Set equipment, then clear it and assert service_type resets.
scenarios.assertion: Service Type dropdown resets when equipment is cleared.

scenarios.description: Scope check: service_type dropdown shows only items from the user's current_user_org.
